annotations.title: The stores' dated rules, and which apps they touch

description: The App Store's and Google Play's rules with a date that Ploa knows (the Xcode a build must come from, Google Play's target SDK, Play's trader status), and each app of the workspace against them: its newest Android build's target SDK next to the one Google asks for now. Use it before planning a release, and when the person asks what's coming.
